Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.headline: One inbox for product updates and admin alerts
Notifications.description: Keep billing, workflow, moderation, and platform alerts in one feed. This mirrors the common SaaS pattern: a quick unread badge in the header, plus a dedicated inbox for the full history.
Notifications.emptyBody: SaaS products usually keep this screen as an inbox: product events, billing updates, moderation changes, and admin alerts all land here in one place.

cards.activityFeedNote: Issue updates, publish runs, workflow events.
cards.adminAlertsNote: Errors, moderation, import or approval events.
